lines.t: Sound the trumpet, roll the battle drum
Called out, girded up, made ready, we come
Valor bred, sin sick, we burn what's behind
No more lukewarm, our faces are lined
With scars of the years, the world's pollution
But now, oh commander, we accept your solution
Men of renown, counted in your vision
Chosen, refined, waging war with decision
We bowed such a face in the day of rebuke
Left on for the call, now the trumpet is truth
Rip the cords, break the chains, flesh on the altar
Grant us the strength not to falter
We cast all aside, cut every tie
Let the world be a tomb and the flesh crucified
Rip the rags, burn the dross
Find us as one, make us yours
Whatever the cost
Rip our bones, strip our pride
Your word as a sword, our flesh as a hide
Lay ready, I'll beat for the war, let your will be done
Blow the trumpet, roar
Witnesses rise, the earth is in labor
Set to the task, for vengeance and favor
Branded and sealed, for a battle yet spoken
Your name on our heads, our hearts strong but broken
We ain't of the world, our doctrines, our churches
We left all that filth for truth that surges
No more delay, teach our fingers to war
Steel in our hearts, we were made for much more
Tear our flesh from the bone as yours was torn
Make us sons of the promise, not slaves forlorn
Breathe your fire, melt every chain
Let your suffering be our gain
Let our wounds be open still
So your glory can enter, consume and fill
Rip the rags, burn the cross
Find us as one, make us yours
Whatever the cost
Grit our bones, strip our pride
Your word as the sword, our flesh as the hide
Make ready our feet for the war
Let your will be done
Blow the trumpet, roar
Roar, roar, roar, roar
The world is condemned, her pleasures are vapors
We count it as refuse for the joy of our maker
We shout in the darkness, witnesses numbered
144,000 never encumbered
Which shall step ring down the walls of the proud
We trumpet your judgment loud and unbowed
Oh, Commander, King, Master and Friend
Count us worthy, keep us till end
Let your anguish be ours, your justice our cry
Let us truly die so in you we might rise
Oneness in battle, brotherhood won
Until the last trumpet
Till all is done
you
